claims.claim: Focused synthetic regressions exercise every existing structural pre-submit predicate through production delivery logic. Receipts expose one closed surface_cause enum, use MULTIPLE_OR_AMBIGUOUS for simultaneous failures, retain durable SURFACE_UNPROVEN deferral, and perform no insertion.

The diagnostic exports only a fixed enum without DOM, text, URLs, identities, selectors, counts, credentials, endpoints or binding paths. It remains outside durable event records and doorbells, with canonical identity, freshness, semantic flow, authority, next_action and lifecycle logic unchanged.

Shared structural observation preserves existing selectors and exact-target, draft, generation, outbound-duplicate and post-submit protections, including disabled-composer BUSY-to-IDLE tracking. All specified timeout, observation, recheck and scheduling budgets remain unchanged.

Deterministic recovery coverage retains deferred subjects, blocks unknown canonical freshness, rechecks freshness before insertion and click, and submits once when the same synthetic page becomes healthy. Resolved subjects NOOP; ambiguous attempts reconcile proof without resending.
The committed delta changes only the three authorized files, with no workflow, browser-launch, scheduler, second-transport, semantic-router, lifecycle-reducer or assistant-output scraping change.

The H4B document records RUN-285-001 RESULT delivery as DEFERRED/SURFACE_UNPROVEN and later same-transport publication delivery as SUBMITTED/EXACT_USER_TURN_PROVEN. It identifies an opaque transient observation gap, prohibits replay of the resolved RESULT, and retains future real unresolved checkpoint observation as the H4B closure requirement.
